name: bakery-landing
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project bakery-landing --web

metadata.description: Copies the product images rendered from the 3D models (DB13) at the commit pinned in produkte-3d-bilder.lock.json from the local-only data repo ../produkte-3d (PRODUKTE_3D_DIR) into public/produkte-3d/ and writes produkte-3d-bilder.json (both git-ignored); checks WebP size, alpha and that each image was rendered from the model of that commit. No data repo (CI, deploy, other machines) or no commit in the lock: empty index, no folder, exit 0 - the export is the same as without images. LANDING_PRODUKTBILDER_FIXTURE=1: the synthetic images in src/test/fixtures/produktbilder. The build targets run the script themselves; `serve` depends on this target.

options.command: node scripts/sync-produktbilder.js && node scripts/generate-sitemap.js && NX_STANDALONE_BUILD=1 npx next build

metadata.description: Static export to apps/bakery-landing/out. Never cached: what goes into out/ depends on things Nx cannot hash - hq outside the workspace, the git-ignored product images (sync-produktbilder) and the fixture flag; a cached build could put real images into a fixture build or the other way round. Uses the standalone path: withNx() builds a nested Nx project graph inside `next build`, which fails on CI, and the landing app imports no workspace libs at build time, so it needs nothing withNx provides.
